fusions.name: Bulwark Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the ground around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Hard Rebuke
fusions.desc: Cracks the target with your armoured jaw, dealing 5 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and healing you for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Raised Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Battered Hide
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
